sentences.en: Let Z one through Z n be a finite block from a real stationary Gaussian noise process.
sentences.zh: 令Z₁至Zₙ是实平稳高斯噪声过程的有限块。

sentences.en: Stationarity makes covariance depend only on the index difference.
sentences.zh: 平稳性使协方差只依赖索引差。

sentences.en: Write K sub i j as r of i minus j.
sentences.zh: 写作K_ij=r(i−j)。

sentences.en: Every diagonal therefore repeats the same covariance lag.
sentences.zh: 因此每条对角线都重复同一协方差时滞。

sentences.en: The resulting finite matrix is Toeplitz.
sentences.zh: 所得有限矩阵是Toeplitz矩阵。

sentences.en: Assume the finite-block covariance matrix is positive definite.
sentences.zh: 假设有限块协方差矩阵正定。

sentences.en: For a Gaussian vector, an orthogonal eigenbasis diagonalizes this covariance.
sentences.zh: 对高斯向量，正交特征基可对角化该协方差。

sentences.en: Rotating into that basis produces independent Gaussian noise modes.
sentences.zh: 旋转到该基底后，得到相互独立的高斯噪声模式。

sentences.en: Their variances are the covariance eigenvalues lambda one through lambda n.
sentences.zh: 各模式方差就是协方差特征值λ₁至λₙ。

sentences.en: The expected block energy budget is n times P.
sentences.zh: 整块的期望能量预算为nP。

sentences.en: Orthogonal rotation preserves squared Euclidean norm, so it preserves this energy budget.
sentences.zh: 正交旋转保持欧氏范数平方，因此保持该能量预算。

sentences.en: Let capital P sub i denote input variance allocated to eigenmode i.
sentences.zh: 令大写P_i表示分配给第i个特征模式的输入方差。

sentences.en: Independent Gaussian inputs attain the parallel-mode information bound established earlier.
sentences.zh: 独立高斯输入达到前面推导的并行模式信息上界。

sentences.en: For allocations P sub i, normalized block information is the sum of log terms divided by two n.
sentences.zh: 对分配P_i，归一化分组信息为对数项之和除以2n。

sentences.en: Maximizing this expression under the block budget gives capacity C sub n.
sentences.zh: 在分组预算约束下最大化该式，得到容量C_n。

sentences.en: Each term is log two of one plus P sub i over lambda sub i.
sentences.zh: 每项为log₂(1+P_i/λ_i)。

sentences.en: The allocations are nonnegative and sum to at most n P.
sentences.zh: 各分配非负且总和不超过nP。

sentences.en: Eigenvectors are exact finite-block modes.
sentences.zh: 特征向量是精确的有限块模式。

sentences.en: At finite n, must these eigenvectors be exactly the discrete Fourier vectors?
sentences.zh: 有限n时，这些特征向量一定恰好是离散Fourier向量吗？

sentences.en: Consider a noise covariance with r zero equal one.
sentences.zh: 考虑r₀=1的噪声协方差。

sentences.en: Let the lag-one covariances r plus one and r minus one equal point three.
sentences.zh: 令一阶协方差r₁与r₋₁均为0.3。

sentences.en: All other nonzero-lag covariances vanish.
sentences.zh: 其他非零时滞协方差均为零。

sentences.en: The finite matrix is tridiagonal with point three on adjacent diagonals.
sentences.zh: 有限矩阵为三对角矩阵，相邻对角线元素为0.3。

sentences.en: Its spectral density is one plus point six cosine omega.
sentences.zh: 其谱密度为1+0.6cosω。

sentences.en: This density stays between point four and one point six.
sentences.zh: 该谱密度始终介于0.4与1.6之间。

sentences.en: The noise spectrum is therefore strictly positive.
sentences.zh: 因此噪声谱严格为正。

sentences.en: The finite eigenvalues are one plus zero point six times the cosine of the fraction k times pi divided by the quantity n plus one.
sentences.zh: 有限特征值为1+0.6cos(kπ/(n+1))。

sentences.en: Here k ranges from one through n.
sentences.zh: 这里k从1取到n。

sentences.en: The corresponding eigenvectors are sine vectors, not finite discrete Fourier vectors.
sentences.zh: 对应特征向量是正弦向量，而非有限离散Fourier向量。

sentences.en: This example shows why finite modes and frequency bins must be distinguished.
sentences.zh: 此例说明必须区分有限模式与频率格点。

sentences.en: At large block lengths, eigenvalue distributions can approach the spectrum.
sentences.zh: 块长增大时，特征值分布可以趋近谱分布。

sentences.en: That statement needs regularity assumptions.
sentences.zh: 该结论需要正则性假设。

sentences.en: Stationarity alone is not enough for every spectral limit.
sentences.zh: 仅有平稳性不足以保证所有谱极限。

sentences.en: We next state one sufficient Toeplitz theorem setting.
sentences.zh: 接下来说明一种充分的Toeplitz定理条件。

sentences.en: The theorem concerns empirical eigenvalue averages, not termwise matching.
sentences.zh: 定理讨论特征值经验平均，而非逐项匹配。

sentences.en: This distinction will matter when applying water-filling.
sentences.zh: 应用注水法时，这一区别很重要。

sentences.en: Finite eigenvalues remain the exact starting point for each block.
sentences.zh: 每个分组仍以精确有限特征值为起点。

sentences.en: The asymptotic spectrum replaces their empirical distribution under stated hypotheses.
sentences.zh: 满足明确假设时，渐近谱可替代其经验分布。

sentences.en: No continuous-time units have entered yet.
sentences.zh: 此处尚未引入连续时间单位。

sentences.en: We are still counting bits per real transmission, after dividing block information by n.
sentences.zh: 分组信息除以n后，单位仍为每次实传输比特数。

sentences.en: Let r of k be an absolutely summable covariance sequence.
sentences.zh: 令r(k)为绝对可和的协方差序列。

sentences.en: Its Fourier series defines a continuous real nonnegative spectrum S of omega.
sentences.zh: 其Fourier级数定义连续、实且非负的谱S(ω)。

sentences.en: Build the n by n Toeplitz covariance matrix from these lags.
sentences.zh: 用这些时滞构造n乘n Toeplitz协方差矩阵。

sentences.en: Let lambda one through lambda n be its eigenvalues.
sentences.zh: 令λ₁至λₙ为该矩阵特征值。

sentences.en: For every continuous test function F, the eigenvalue average converges.
sentences.zh: 对每个连续测试函数F，特征值平均值均收敛。

sentences.en: The limit is the integral of F of S omega, divided by the product of two and pi.
sentences.zh: 极限为(1/(2π))∫F(S(ω))dω。

sentences.en: The integral runs from negative pi to pi.
sentences.zh: 积分区间为−π至π。

sentences.en: This is convergence of empirical distributions.
sentences.zh: 这是经验分布的收敛。

sentences.en: It does not pair every finite eigenvalue with one exact frequency.
sentences.zh: 它不把每个有限特征值与某个精确频率配对。

sentences.en: Here is the proof roadmap, not a full theorem proof.
sentences.zh: 下面给出证明路线，而非完整定理证明。

sentences.en: First truncate the absolutely summable covariance sequence to a finite lag range.
sentences.zh: 首先将绝对可和协方差序列截断到有限时滞范围。

sentences.en: For the truncated sequence, first consider polynomial test functions of the eigenvalues.
sentences.zh: 对截断序列，先考虑特征值的多项式测试函数。

sentences.en: Normalized traces of powers are sums of products of covariance lags.
sentences.zh: 归一化幂迹是协方差时滞乘积之和。

sentences.en: For fixed polynomial degree and lag range, only a fixed-width boundary differs.
sentences.zh: 对固定多项式次数与时滞范围，只有固定宽度的边界部分不同。

sentences.en: That boundary contribution divided by n tends to zero.
sentences.zh: 该边界贡献除以n后趋于零。

sentences.en: Absolute summability makes the truncation error vanish as the lag range grows.
sentences.zh: 时滞范围增大时，绝对可和性使截断误差趋于零。

sentences.en: Thus the limit holds for polynomial test functions.
sentences.zh: 因此该极限对多项式测试函数成立。

sentences.en: On the compact spectral interval, approximate continuous F uniformly by polynomials.
sentences.zh: 在紧谱区间上，用多项式一致逼近连续函数F。

sentences.en: Uniform approximation transfers the limit to F.
sentences.zh: 一致逼近将极限推广到F。

sentences.en: This argument requires absolute summability and continuity as stated.
sentences.zh: 该论证需要前述绝对可和与连续性条件。

sentences.en: For water-filling, assume additionally that S is bounded below by a positive m.
sentences.zh: 对注水法，还假设S有正下界m。

sentences.en: Assume it is bounded above by a finite M as well.
sentences.zh: 同时假设其有有限上界M。

sentences.en: For fixed water level nu, allocated power is the positive part of nu minus S.
sentences.zh: 固定水位ν时，功率密度为(ν−S)^+。

sentences.en: This function is continuous in the spectral value.
sentences.zh: 该函数关于谱值连续。

sentences.en: So the eigenvalue theorem gives its empirical mean limit.
sentences.zh: 因此特征值定理给出其经验均值极限。

sentences.en: The capacity integrand is continuous under the same positive bounds.
sentences.zh: 在相同正下界条件下，容量被积函数连续。

sentences.en: For positive P, choose the finite-block water level to meet its power budget.
sentences.zh: 对正功率P，选择有限块水位以满足功率预算。

sentences.en: Bracket the limiting water level by two nearby fixed levels. How can this constrain nu sub n?
sentences.zh: 用两个相邻固定水位夹住极限水位。这如何约束ν_n？

sentences.en: Monotonicity of allocated power transfers this bracket to nu sub n.
sentences.zh: 分配功率的单调性将该夹逼传递给ν_n。

sentences.en: As the bracket narrows, nu sub n converges to nu.
sentences.zh: 夹逼区间收窄时，ν_n趋于ν。

sentences.en: Continuity then transfers the limit to the optimized capacity.
sentences.zh: 随后由连续性将极限传递到最优容量。

sentences.en: When P is zero, all allocations and capacities vanish without requiring a unique water level.
sentences.zh: P为零时，各功率分配与容量均为零，无需唯一水位。

sentences.en: These steps do not assert the result for every stationary process.
sentences.zh: 这些步骤并未断言该结果适用于所有平稳过程。

sentences.en: These conclusions use absolute summability together with a continuous spectrum bounded away from zero.
sentences.zh: 这些结论采用绝对可和性，以及有正下界的连续谱。

sentences.en: Finite-block fluctuations remain before taking the limit.
sentences.zh: 取极限之前，有限块波动仍然存在。

sentences.en: Next translate these discrete frequencies into physical hertz.
sentences.zh: 接下来将离散频率换算为物理赫兹。

sentences.en: The normalization changes with that translation.
sentences.zh: 这种换算会改变归一化方式。

sentences.en: First use discrete time with normalized frequency omega.
sentences.zh: 首先考虑归一化角频率ω下的离散时间模型。

sentences.en: Its angular frequency ranges from negative pi to positive pi.
sentences.zh: 其角频率范围为−π至π。

sentences.en: Define the input spectrum S sub x under a two-sided convention.
sentences.zh: 按双边约定定义输入谱S_x。

sentences.en: Average input power is its spectral integral divided by the product of two and pi.
sentences.zh: 平均输入功率为(1/(2π))乘谱积分。

sentences.en: That integral runs from negative pi to pi.
sentences.zh: 积分区间为−π至π。

sentences.en: For a real discrete-time Gaussian channel, capacity is the log integral divided by the product of four and pi.
sentences.zh: 对实离散时间高斯信道，容量为(1/(4π))乘以对数积分。

sentences.en: The integrand is log two of one plus S x over S z.
sentences.zh: 被积函数为log₂(1+S_x/S_z)。

sentences.en: Its unit is bits per real discrete-time use.
sentences.zh: 其单位是每次实离散时间使用的比特数。

sentences.en: The one half accounts for a real degree of freedom.
sentences.zh: 因子二分之一来自实自由度。

sentences.en: The discrete-time water-filling spectrum is the positive part of nu minus S z.
sentences.zh: 离散时间注水谱为(ν−S_z)^+。

sentences.en: Now use continuous time and frequency f in hertz.
sentences.zh: 现在考虑以赫兹计量的连续时间频率f。

sentences.en: For a real signal, integrate over both positive and negative frequencies.
sentences.zh: 对实信号，要对正负频率两侧积分。

sentences.en: Transmit power is the integral of S x over the real line.
sentences.zh: 发送功率为S_x在实数频率轴上的积分。

sentences.en: Continuous-time capacity is one half the log integral over hertz.
sentences.zh: 连续时间容量为赫兹域对数积分的一半。

sentences.en: It equals one half integral over the reals of log two of one plus S x over S z.
sentences.zh: 即实数域上log₂(1+S_x/S_z)积分的一半。

sentences.en: Its unit is bits per second.
sentences.zh: 其单位为比特每秒。

sentences.en: Here S x and S z use power per hertz.
sentences.zh: 这里S_x与S_z均采用功率每赫兹单位。

sentences.en: Their ratio is dimensionless.
sentences.zh: 二者之比是无量纲量。

sentences.en: For alias-free sampling, band-limit signal and observed noise to negative W through W, and sample at two W.
sentences.zh: 无混叠采样时，将信号与观测噪声限于−W至W，并以2W采样。

sentences.en: Map hertz f to omega: f equals F s times omega, divided by the product of two and pi.
sentences.zh: 用f=F_sω/(2π)将赫兹频率映射到ω。

sentences.en: The discrete spectrum equals F s times the continuous spectrum at that frequency.
sentences.zh: 离散谱等于该频率处连续谱乘F_s。

sentences.en: Thus the signal-to-noise spectral ratio is unchanged.
sentences.zh: 因此信噪谱比保持不变。

sentences.en: In the discrete integral, d omega equals two pi divided by F s, times d f.
sentences.zh: 频率微分按2π/F_s缩放。

sentences.en: Multiplying discrete bits per use by F s uses per second gives bits per second.
sentences.zh: 将每次使用比特数乘以每秒F_s次，得到比特每秒。

sentences.en: This exactly yields the continuous-time half-integral convention.
sentences.zh: 这恰好得到连续时间的半积分约定。

sentences.en: Now take white noise with two-sided density N zero over two.
sentences.zh: 现在令白噪声双边谱密度为N₀/2。

sentences.en: Restrict transmission to the lowpass band from negative W to positive W.
sentences.zh: 将发送限制在−W至W的低通频带。

sentences.en: Uniform optimal input density is P divided by the product of two and W.
sentences.zh: 均匀最优输入谱密度为P/(2W)。

sentences.en: Its power integral over width two W equals P.
sentences.zh: 该谱密度在总宽2W上积分为P。

sentences.en: The ratio to noise density becomes P divided by the product N zero times W.
sentences.zh: 与噪声谱密度之比变为P/(N₀W)。

sentences.en: The capacity integral reduces to W times log base two of one plus the ratio P divided by the product N zero times W.
sentences.zh: 容量积分化为Wlog₂(1+P/(N₀W))。

sentences.en: This matches the real lowpass formula from the bandwidth episode.
sentences.zh: 这与带宽章节的实低通公式一致。

sentences.en: The half factor and the two-sided band must travel together.
sentences.zh: 二分之一因子与双边频带必须配套使用。

sentences.en: Changing to one-sided spectra requires consistent conversion.
sentences.zh: 改用单边谱时必须一致换算。

sentences.en: Next consider frequency response before assigning the effective noise floor.
sentences.zh: 接下来先考虑频率响应，再定义有效噪声底。

sentences.en: Consider a linear time-invariant channel with frequency response H of f.
sentences.zh: 考虑频率响应为H(f)的线性时不变信道。

sentences.en: The transmitted signal spectrum is S x of f.
sentences.zh: 发送信号谱为S_x(f)。

sentences.en: The receiver observes H times X plus additive noise N.
sentences.zh: 接收端观测H乘X再加加性噪声N。

sentences.en: The input power constraint applies before H.
sentences.zh: 输入功率约束施加在H之前。

sentences.en: The signal contribution to output spectrum is absolute H squared times S x.
sentences.zh: 输出谱中的信号项为|H|²S_x。

sentences.en: Let additive noise have spectrum S n of f.
sentences.zh: 令加性噪声谱为S_n(f)。

sentences.en: At a frequency with nonzero H, output signal-to-noise ratio is absolute H squared times S x, all divided by S n.
sentences.zh: 在H非零的频率，输出信噪比为|H|²S_x/S_n。

sentences.en: Equivalently, the effective input noise floor is S n over absolute H squared.
sentences.zh: 等价地，有效输入噪声底为S_n/|H|²。

sentences.en: This equivalent floor is defined only when H is nonzero.
sentences.zh: 该等效噪声底仅在H非零时定义。

sentences.en: When H equals zero and noise remains positive, no input signal passes.
sentences.zh: 当H为零且噪声仍为正时，没有输入信号通过。

sentences.en: That mode carries zero information.
sentences.zh: 该模式承载零信息。

sentences.en: The effective-noise quotient is undefined there; the direct signal-to-noise expression gives zero.
sentences.zh: 该处等效噪声商未定义；直接信噪比表达式给出零。

sentences.en: A zero at an isolated frequency has measure zero in a continuous integral.
sentences.zh: 连续积分中单个孤立频率的测度为零。

sentences.en: Such a point does not automatically remove positive integral capacity.
sentences.zh: 因此该点不会自动损失正的积分容量。

sentences.en: Assume S n is strictly positive wherever the formula is used.
sentences.zh: 假设公式使用处的S_n严格为正。

sentences.en: A zero-noise mode lies outside this stated formula regime.
sentences.zh: 零噪声模式不属于此处声明的公式范围。

sentences.en: Their capacity requires separate assumptions on the noiseless degrees of freedom and admissible inputs.
sentences.zh: 其容量需要另行声明无噪自由度与允许输入的假设。

sentences.en: Now place a receive filter G after the additive noise.
sentences.zh: 现在将接收滤波器G置于加性噪声之后。

sentences.en: It multiplies the signal spectrum by absolute G squared.
sentences.zh: 它将信号谱乘以|G|²。

sentences.en: It also multiplies the noise spectrum by absolute G squared. Can amplification alone improve their ratio?
sentences.zh: 它也将噪声谱乘以|G|²。仅靠放大能提高二者比值吗？

sentences.en: Where G is nonzero, these factors cancel in their ratio.
sentences.zh: G非零处，这些因子在比值中抵消。

sentences.en: Thus receive weighting alone cannot improve that modewise signal-to-noise ratio.
sentences.zh: 因此仅靠接收加权不能提高该模式信噪比。

sentences.en: This cancellation does not reverse the location of the transmitter power constraint.
sentences.zh: 这种抵消不会改变发射功率约束的位置。

sentences.en: Thus an invertible receive weighting does not change that mode ratio.
sentences.zh: 因此可逆接收加权不会改变该模式信噪比。

sentences.en: Where G is zero, the filter erases the mode.
sentences.zh: G为零处，滤波器会抹去该模式。

sentences.en: There the ratio is not evaluated by cancelling zero over zero.
sentences.zh: 此处不能通过抵消0/0来计算比值。

sentences.en: Input filtering and receive filtering have different power consequences.
sentences.zh: 输入滤波与接收滤波对功率约束的影响不同。

sentences.en: The transmitter pays for power before the channel response.
sentences.zh: 发射端为信道响应之前的功率付出预算。

sentences.en: A receive filter acts after signal and noise arrive.
sentences.zh: 接收滤波器作用于信号与噪声到达之后。

sentences.en: A frequency-dependent H can make some modes more favorable.
sentences.zh: 频率相关的H会使某些模式更有利。

sentences.en: Power allocation should account for that effective signal-to-noise ratio.
sentences.zh: 功率分配应考虑该有效信噪比。

sentences.en: The spectrum integral must retain its stated units and domain.
sentences.zh: 谱积分必须保留声明的单位与定义域。

sentences.en: The power constraint remains the integral of the transmitted input spectrum.
sentences.zh: 功率约束始终是发送输入谱的积分。

sentences.en: Next state the separate finite-block result for causal feedback.
sentences.zh: 接下来陈述因果反馈的独立有限块结果。

sentences.en: Its half-bit comparison is per real transmission, not per second.
sentences.zh: 其半比特比较按每次实传输计，而非每秒。

sentences.en: Now return to a discrete-time real additive Gaussian sequence channel.
sentences.zh: 现在回到离散时间实加性高斯序列信道。

sentences.en: The block noise is Gaussian with positive-definite covariance and may be nonstationary.
sentences.zh: 分组噪声为协方差正定的高斯噪声，且可以非平稳。

sentences.en: No stationarity or Toeplitz structure is required for this finite-block comparison.
sentences.zh: 该有限块比较不要求平稳性或Toeplitz结构。

sentences.en: Its coordinates may be correlated across time.
sentences.zh: 其坐标可以在时间上相关。

sentences.en: The noise is independent of the message.
sentences.zh: 噪声与消息独立。

sentences.en: The transmitter has noiseless causal access to previous channel outputs.
sentences.zh: 发送端无噪声地因果获知先前信道输出。

sentences.en: Thus input X sub i may depend on Y before time i.
sentences.zh: 因此输入X_i可依赖时刻i之前的输出。

sentences.en: The power constraint averages expected squared input across the block.
sentences.zh: 功率约束对整个分组的输入平方取期望平均。

sentences.en: One over n times the sum of expected X sub i squared is at most P.
sentences.zh: (1/n)ΣE[X_i²]≤P。

sentences.en: This is an expected average-power constraint.
sentences.zh: 这是期望平均功率约束。

sentences.en: It is not a separate deterministic bound on every message codeword.
sentences.zh: 它不是对每个消息码字分别施加的确定性约束。

sentences.en: Cover and Pombra give finite-block comparisons for this model.
sentences.zh: Cover与Pombra为该模型给出有限块比较界。

sentences.en: Let C sub n denote the normalized no-feedback information bound.
sentences.zh: 令C_n表示归一化无反馈信息界。

sentences.en: It divides the best no-feedback block information by n transmissions.
sentences.zh: 它将无反馈最优分组信息量除以n次传输。

sentences.en: Let C sub n feedback denote the corresponding feedback quantity.
sentences.zh: 令C_{n,fb}表示相应的反馈量。

sentences.en: The feedback quantity uses the same normalization and power budget.
sentences.zh: 反馈量采用相同归一化与功率预算。

sentences.en: Their comparison is C n at most C n feedback.
sentences.zh: 其比较关系为C_n≤C_{n,fb}。

sentences.en: The feedback quantity is at most the smaller of twice C sub n and C sub n plus one half. Is that half a bit per second?
sentences.zh: 反馈量至多为2C_n与C_n+1/2中的较小值。这里是每秒半比特吗？

sentences.en: These quantities are measured in bits per real transmission.
sentences.zh: 这些量以每次实传输比特数计量。

sentences.en: The half-bit increment is not a universal half bit per second.
sentences.zh: 半比特增量不是通用的每秒半比特。

sentences.en: A conversion to bits per second needs an explicit use rate.
sentences.zh: 换算成比特每秒需要明确的使用速率。

sentences.en: It also needs a continuous-time model with matching bandwidth assumptions.
sentences.zh: 还需要具有匹配带宽假设的连续时间模型。

sentences.en: This is an invoked advanced comparison, not a derivation here.
sentences.zh: 这里引用这项高级比较结果，而不作推导。

sentences.en: It is not a finite-block zero-error guarantee.
sentences.zh: 它不是有限块零错误保证。

sentences.en: Nor does it make every feedback code attain the upper bound.
sentences.zh: 它也不意味着每个反馈码都能达到上界。

sentences.en: Memoryless Gaussian channels have no feedback capacity increase.
sentences.zh: 无记忆高斯信道的容量不会因反馈而增加。

sentences.en: That agrees with the memoryless-channel argument from earlier.
sentences.zh: 这与前面对无记忆信道的论证一致。

sentences.en: Colored noise has memory that feedback can exploit.
sentences.zh: 彩色噪声具有反馈可能利用的记忆。

sentences.en: Its finite-block comparison therefore has a different scope.
sentences.zh: 因此其有限块比较具有不同适用范围。

sentences.en: Keep the message, causal outputs, and current input in time order.
sentences.zh: 应按时间顺序排列消息、过去输出与当前输入。

sentences.en: Feedback cannot depend on future outputs.
sentences.zh: 反馈不能依赖未来输出。

sentences.en: The stated covariance and power assumptions matter to the result.
sentences.zh: 声明的协方差与功率假设对该结果至关重要。

sentences.en: This bound concerns a real discrete-time sequence channel.
sentences.zh: 该界针对实离散时间序列信道。

sentences.en: It does not automatically extend to every continuous spectrum.
sentences.zh: 它不会自动推广到每种连续频谱模型。

sentences.en: The final chapter will connect source rates and channel budgets.
sentences.zh: 最后一章将连接信源速率与信道预算。

sentences.en: It will preserve each theorem’s assumptions and units.
sentences.zh: 它将保留各定理的假设与单位。

sentences.en: A source produces symbols that must be represented or transmitted with a specified error requirement.
sentences.zh: 信源产生符号，需要在明确错误要求下表示或传输。

sentences.en: For a finite memoryless source, typical code lengths are governed by entropy.
sentences.zh: 有限无记忆信源的典型码长由熵控制。

sentences.en: For a stationary ergodic finite-alphabet source, entropy rate replaces single-symbol entropy.
sentences.zh: 对平稳遍历有限字母表信源，熵率取代单符号熵。

sentences.en: The source coding theorem states its own asymptotic assumptions.
sentences.zh: 信源编码定理有其自身渐近假设。

sentences.en: The channel coding theorem asks whether messages can cross reliably.
sentences.zh: 信道编码定理讨论消息能否可靠传输。

sentences.en: For a discrete memoryless channel, capacity is maximum mutual information per use.
sentences.zh: 对离散无记忆信道，容量是每次使用最大互信息。

sentences.en: For real AWGN, the unit is bits per real channel use.
sentences.zh: 对实AWGN，单位是每次实信道使用比特数。

sentences.en: For continuous-time real lowpass AWGN, capacity is measured in bits per second.
sentences.zh: 对连续时间实低通AWGN，容量单位为比特每秒。

sentences.en: Bandwidth converts real uses per second into a physical rate.
sentences.zh: 带宽将每秒实使用次数转换为物理速率。

sentences.en: A sequence of m source symbols requires about m times entropy rate bits.
sentences.zh: m个信源符号约需要m乘熵率个比特。

sentences.en: A channel block of n uses offers about n times capacity bits.
sentences.zh: n次信道使用约提供n乘容量个比特。

sentences.en: A strict gap suffices for reliable separation under the source and channel coding assumptions.
sentences.zh: 在信源与信道编码假设下，严格余量足以保证可靠分离。

sentences.en: Let block lengths grow with a fixed source-to-channel ratio.
sentences.zh: 令分组长度增长，同时保持信源块与信道块的固定比例。

sentences.en: Choose m times entropy rate less than n times capacity.
sentences.zh: 选择m乘熵率小于n乘容量。

sentences.en: Writing rho as m over n, the strict condition is rho times entropy rate below capacity.
sentences.zh: 令ρ=m/n，严格条件为ρ乘熵率小于容量。

sentences.en: The channel model and source theorem hypotheses must both hold.
sentences.zh: 信道模型与信源定理假设必须同时成立。

sentences.en: A fixed positive margin lets both coding error probabilities vanish.
sentences.zh: 固定正余量可使两端编码错误概率都趋于零。

sentences.en: A converse requires the source rate not exceed capacity. Does this inequality itself certify achievability at equality?
sentences.zh: 反向结论要求信源速率不超过容量。这条不等式本身能证明等号处可达吗？

sentences.en: At equality, asymptotic achievability itself needs separate analysis.
sentences.zh: 等号边界处，渐近可达性本身也需要单独分析。

sentences.en: The entropy rate has units of bits per source symbol.
sentences.zh: 熵率单位是每个信源符号的比特数。

sentences.en: Channel capacity has units of bits per channel use.
sentences.zh: 信道容量单位是每次信道使用的比特数。

sentences.en: When capacity is positive, entropy rate divided by capacity gives the asymptotic threshold of channel uses per source symbol.
sentences.zh: 容量为正时，熵率除以容量给出每信源符号所需信道使用次数的渐近门槛。

sentences.en: AWGN capacity turns available power and noise into a rate.
sentences.zh: AWGN容量将可用功率与噪声转换为速率。

sentences.en: Water-filling distributes a shared power budget across parallel modes.
sentences.zh: 注水法将共享功率预算分配到并行模式。

sentences.en: Toeplitz eigenvalue limits connect stationary covariance to asymptotic modes.
sentences.zh: Toeplitz特征值极限将平稳协方差连接到渐近模式。

sentences.en: That connection needs spectral regularity such as absolute summability.
sentences.zh: 该连接需要绝对可和等谱正则条件。

sentences.en: Continuous-time spectra require hertz and two-sided density conventions.
sentences.zh: 连续时间频谱需要明确赫兹与双边谱密度约定。

sentences.en: A finite-block feedback bound returns to bits per real transmission.
sentences.zh: 有限块反馈界则回到每次实传输比特数。

sentences.en: No per-use constant becomes a rate without an explicit use rate.
sentences.zh: 没有明确使用速率时，每次使用常数不能变成速率。

sentences.en: Each result therefore carries a model, a limit, and a unit.
sentences.zh: 因此每个结果都带有模型、极限与单位。

sentences.en: Computed examples illustrate formulas but do not replace proofs.
sentences.zh: 计算示例用于说明公式，却不能替代证明。

sentences.en: The Gaussian feedback comparison is an invoked result under its covariance, causality, and expected-power assumptions.
sentences.zh: 高斯反馈比较是在其协方差、因果性与期望功率假设下引用的结果。

sentences.en: The spectral water-fill limit is likewise conditional on Toeplitz hypotheses.
sentences.zh: 谱注水极限同样依赖Toeplitz假设。

sentences.en: Together, entropy, coding, capacity, and allocation form a reusable chain.
sentences.zh: 熵、编码、容量与分配共同构成可复用推理链。

sentences.en: A new source or channel model requires new assumptions.
sentences.zh: 新的信源或信道模型需要新的假设。

sentences.en: Nonstationary or non-Gaussian extensions are not automatic.
sentences.zh: 非平稳或非高斯推广并非自动成立。

sentences.en: Given a source and a channel, first express their information budgets in matching units.
sentences.zh: 面对一个信源和一个信道，先用一致的单位表达它们的信息预算。

sentences.en: Then identify the assumptions that justify compression, transmission, and allocation. That makes the budget usable.
sentences.zh: 再确定压缩、传输和分配各自依赖的假设，这样才能运用这个预算。
